notes.title: New PRICE !
notes.content:
I really want to thank all of you who bought my "game " and helped me with development. I know that I don't post updates as often as many of you would like to. I`m just a solo developer but I try my best. 

I`m changing the price of the game to 5$ for all the time. No more occasional sale price drops, just flat 5$.

If you feel that the price for your region is too high because of the USD exchange, please contact me and I will adjust the pricing.

as a bonus, I added 15 Steam achievements for those who like to collect them.

notes.title: New Features
notes.content:
I have added a few shortcuts to speed up unit setup and manipulation. Here is the list:
L - Line of Sight
R - Rotate Unit
M - Move unit
N - Toggle Show/Hide Unit name
H - Toggle Show/Hide ALL Units Names
[ - spawn new custom unit on base (ground units)
] - spawn new custom unit on stand (air units)

Also, there are a few features:
-Distance display for Line of Sight
-Duplicate Unit Option (in the right mouse button menu) for faster NPC spawning.
